research_question: When ordinary lexical YV/KV lookup is insufficient, can users express their work or competence in ordinary language well enough for a stream-specific simple deterministic fallback candidate to surface a canonical result they recognize and a blind taxonomy adjudicator accepts?
non_claims: users usually do not know taxonomy vocabulary
KV evidence transfers to occupation discovery
a recruited capability study estimates production prevalence

occupation.entrypoint: Beskriv vad du gör i jobbet
occupation.candidate: YV-description-full-v0 research build over all active occupation-name identities; it must be evaluated and frozen before occupation participant collection; the current 165-target C2 remains a regression/demo reference only
occupation.adjudication_identity: all active v31 occupation-name identities; do not force job-title context or nearest concept
occupation.demand_envelope: all 2,105 active v31 occupation-name identities; historical P80 membership is a demand-priority stratum, not an eligibility or capability boundary

skill.entrypoint: Beskriv vad du kan eller gör
skill.demand_envelope: 316 frozen P80 skills; record envelope membership per acceptable target and never coerce an out-of-envelope target to the nearest P80 skill
skill.must_not_promote: query-only numeric sanitation or any higher-complexity candidate

evidence_order: preregistration is completed, placeholder-free, committed and frozen before the first real participant
participant description captured without retrieval output and without example text naming or strongly cueing a target
description plus minimal non-sensitive metadata frozen
at least one taxonomy-domain adjudicator maps the description to zero, one or multiple acceptable canonical identities while blind to retrieval output; uncertain/unmappable is a valid outcome
adjudication frozen with per-target demand-envelope membership
manifest records SHA-256 hashes of preregistration, elicitation and adjudication before retrieval
ordinary lexical baseline and the frozen stream-specific simple fallback candidate are run
participant may then inspect fallback candidate labels and record recognize/select/none
only after outcome freeze may residuals be classified

decision_bearing_fields_include: data-handling basis and repository redaction process
preregistration.changing_decision_rules_after_retrieval: starts a new study version; never silently rewrites the frozen study

need_measurement.production_prevalence: requires an aggregate funnel denominator outside the human case files: eligible lexical-failure/retry exposures, fallback offers/views, opens, submissions and selections. Raw free text is not required for these counts.
need_measurement.capability_study: may report stated willingness/usefulness and completion among recruited/prompted participants, but must not call that production uptake or prevalence.
need_measurement.separation_rule: never use N submitted human descriptions as the denominator for prevalence among all lexical failures

elicitation.occupation_prompt: Beskriv vad du gör eller gjorde på jobbet utan att skriva yrkestiteln. Beskriv arbetsuppgifter, verktyg eller system, arbetsmiljö och ansvar som känns viktiga.
elicitation.skill_prompt: Beskriv en konkret kompetens du använder i arbete utan att skriva namnet på kompetensen. Berätta vad du gör, med vilka verktyg eller metoder och vilket resultat du försöker uppnå.
elicitation.reason_no_examples: example text can anchor vocabulary and contaminate the measurement of whether users can naturally express the need
elicitation.minimum_information_rule: do not coach a participant toward a taxonomy term after submission; if the description is insufficient, mark clarification-needed instead of silently enriching it

adjudication.stream_rule: for occupation, every valid active v31 occupation-name target is in the frozen capability universe; P80 membership may be recorded separately as a demand stratum but must not exclude the target from occupation capability scoring

outcomes.recognition_rule: participant_recognized_ids must be a subset of fallback_top5_ids; participant_selected_id must be null or a recognized fallback candidate

need: production fallback open/submit/select fractions only when an aggregate eligible lexical-failure denominator exists
stated willingness/usefulness in recruited capability studies, clearly labeled as stated rather than observed prevalence
fraction of submitted descriptions adjudicated as sufficiently informative without clarification
fraction with at least one acceptable target inside the frozen stream-specific capability universe
capability: Top1 acceptable on sufficiently-informative cases with at least one in-envelope acceptable target
first acceptable rank and mean reciprocal rank (MRR)
nDCG@5 when multiple acceptable identities exist
unacceptable-prefix burden before the first acceptable candidate
candidate-list precision and unacceptable candidates returned over the candidates actually shown
correct fallback abstention for clarification-needed, unmappable and out-of-scope cases
participant recognition and acceptable selection/none behavior
acceptable-target Hit@5 and paired Hit@5 delta versus lexical baseline only as secondary historical recall signals
residual_classification: target outside frozen stream-specific capability universe
retrieval/ranking miss despite adequate in-envelope evidence

reporting_rules: occupation and skill results are never pooled into one accuracy number
report numerator/N and Wilson interval for proportions; do not inflate N with occurrence weights
report unique participants and unique adjudicated target identities alongside query count
ambiguous cases with multiple defensible canonical targets use an acceptable target set rather than forcing one label
per-target demand-envelope membership is preserved for ambiguous cases
for occupation, historical P80 membership is reported only as a demand-priority stratum and must not remove a valid active occupation-name target from capability metrics
unmappable and out-of-envelope cases remain visible in need/coverage reporting even when excluded from in-envelope retrieval accuracy
synthetic/model-authored cases may be used only for regression tests, never to satisfy the human evidence gate
Hit@5 is a secondary recall-style signal and must never be reported alone as product/list quality

complexity_escalation_gate.default: do not test embeddings/neural reranking merely because one human case misses
required_before_higher_model_class: independent human descriptions are frozen before retrieval
at least one acceptable target is adjudicated and inside the current stream-specific capability universe
the description contains adequate discriminating evidence
plain simple candidate materially misses across multiple independent cases and target identities
residual review shows the dominant cause is retrieval semantics rather than taxonomy ambiguity, missing source evidence, UI wording or coverage
a higher-complexity candidate is then frozen before a new independent holdout

product_separation.primary_lexical_path: must remain available and privileged for users who know a title/skill term
product_separation.fallback: secondary explicit route; no claim that semantic interpretation should replace ordinary YV/KV
product_separation.occupation_plus_location_omnibox: separate product hypothesis; commuting-municipality parsing/search must not be conflated with semantic occupation classification
product_separation.example_modal_test: separate UX experiment after the no-example expressibility benchmark; examples must be diverse and must not be used to create retrieval ground truth

privacy.instruction: participants should not include names, personal identifiers, employer identifiers or unnecessary sensitive personal information
privacy.production_telemetry: do not store raw free text by default merely to compute funnel metrics; raw research text requires an explicit approved study/data-handling basis
privacy.reporting: publish only aggregated metrics and carefully redacted examples

stop_rules: if people cannot naturally provide sufficiently informative descriptions, improve or reconsider the interaction before retrieval complexity
if most failures are source/taxonomy problems or, for the skill stream, outside the frozen skill envelope, do not solve them with a larger retrieval model
for occupation, a valid active v31 occupation-name outside historical P80 is not an out-of-envelope case
if simple fallback does not materially improve over lexical baseline on independent human cases, do not ship it merely because synthetic benchmarks are strong
if simple fallback is already sufficient on independent human evidence, stop model work and focus on discoverability, calibration and safe integration
